caption:
Every morning on the trail starts with black coffee, eggs, plantains, and rice and beans.

Every breakfast is included across the 9 days. What you eat carries the mileage: on Day 4, the Queen Stage drops 2,351 metres through the Savegre Valley, and families along the route hand runners fresh coffee and empanadas right from their kitchens.

By the time you reach the Pacific coast, the table is shared among 6 to 8 athletes. Every plate has an origin and a person who made it.

The Trail Running Expedition: 5 – 13 December 2026, 20 – 28 February 2027, and 7 – 15 August 2027. Details in the bio.
